- Activates route monitoring, location sharing, and traffic-aware ETA updates
- Enables destination change feature

**Completing the trip (COMPLETED):**
- Calculates final fare: (baseFare + distance + time + surge - discounts + tolls)
- Charges payment method
- Stops all monitoring services
- Enables rating submission for both parties
